Requires API key authentication. Returns analyzed context (signal, trend direction, momentum, percentile among every stored daily close), not raw values. The signal is bullish, bearish or neutral on crypto series, and above-trend, below-trend or at-trend on every other metric, where the value sits against its trend, so a high yield reads above-trend. Use when you need to understand what a metric means for decision-making, not just its number. A free key reads the 17 metrics in the bitcoin category in full, and the latest reading of the other 189. The basic and pro tiers read every metric in full.
